title: Vegan Mushroom Burgers
subtitle: with black lentils
description: Patties of oven-roasted mushrooms, black lentils and fried onion, bound with a little flour, ketchup and mustard and baked until golden.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line 2 baking trays with baking paper.
Heat a pan with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and fry the chopped onions over medium heat until lightly golden.
Place the mushrooms on a tray, drizzle with about 3 tablespoons olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake the mushrooms for about 15 minutes until slightly browned. Remove and leave the oven on.
Transfer the mushrooms to a food processor and pulse to a coarse puree. Squeeze the puree with your hands and place in a bowl.

Pulse the lentils in the food processor for 1 minute until uniform. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms and mix. Add the fried onion and remaining ingredients and mix well to a sticky mixture that is easy to shape.
Shape the mixture into 6 slightly flattened patties and arrange on a greased tray.
Bake the burgers for about 10 minutes until the colour deepens.
